verses.text: “Don’t judge, so you won’t be judged.
The judgment you give is the judgment you’ll receive, and the measure you use will be used for you.
Why do you notice the speck in your brother’s eye but ignore the beam in your own?
How can you say to your brother, ‘Let me get that speck out of your eye,’ when there’s a beam in your own eye?
You hypocrite! First get the beam out of your own eye. Then you’ll see clearly enough to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
“Don’t give what is holy to dogs, and don’t throw your pearls to pigs. They might trample them, then turn and attack you.
“Ask, and you’ll receive. Seek, and you’ll find. Knock, and the door will be opened for you.
Everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and the one who knocks will have the door opened.
Which of you would give your son a stone if he asked for bread?
Or give him a snake if he asked for a fish?
If you, even though you’re flawed, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
“So treat people the way you want them to treat you. This sums up the Law and the Prophets.
“Enter through the narrow gate. The gate is wide and the road is broad that leads to destruction, and many go in that way.
But the gate is narrow and the road is hard that leads to life, and only a few find it.
“Watch out for false prophets. They come to you dressed like sheep, but inside they’re vicious wolves.
You’ll recognize them by what they produce. Do people pick grapes from thornbushes or figs from thistles?
In the same way, every good tree produces good fruit, but a bad tree produces bad fruit.
A good tree can’t produce bad fruit, and a bad tree can’t produce good fruit.
Every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
So you’ll recognize them by what they produce.
“Not everyone who calls me ‘Lord, Lord’ will enter the Kingdom of Heaven. It’s the one who does the will of my Father in heaven who will enter.
Many will say to me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we speak prophecies in your name, drive out demons in your name, and do many powerful works in your name?’
Then I’ll tell them, ‘I never knew you. Get away from me, you who live in rebellion against God.’
“So everyone who hears these words of mine and lives by them is like a wise man who built his house on rock.
The rain poured down, the floods came, and the winds battered that house, but it didn’t fall because it was built on rock.
Everyone who hears these words of mine but doesn’t live by them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.
The rain poured down, the floods came, and the winds battered that house. It fell, and its collapse was devastating.”
When Jesus finished teaching, the crowds were amazed by what he had taught.
He taught with authority, unlike their scribes.
